plan.title: Improvement by Gender
plan.subtitle: Are girls and boys improving equally?

panels.title: Girls improving
panels.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM (SELECT * FROM baseline WHERE Gender = 'Female') INTERSECT SELECT * FROM endline WHERE Gender = 'Female'

panels.title: Boys improving
panels.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS n FROM (SELECT * FROM baseline WHERE Gender = 'Male') INTERSECT SELECT * FROM endline WHERE Gender = 'Male'

panels.title: Average shuttle run by gender
panels.sql: SELECT Gender, AVG(CASE WHEN baseline."Shuttle run sec" IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE baseline."Shuttle run sec" END) AS avg_shuttle FROM baseline INTERSECT SELECT Gender, AVG(CASE WHEN endline."Shuttle run sec" IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE endline."Shuttle run sec" END) AS avg_shuttle FROM endline GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC

panels.title: Girls and boys by location
panels.sql: SELECT Gender, Location, COUNT(*) AS n FROM baseline INTERSECT SELECT Gender, Location, COUNT(*) AS n FROM endline GROUP BY 1, 2
